reviews.ownership_check: The A2A Protocol project remains the official authority for the versioned A2A specification.
reviews.finding: A2A 1.0.0 is now the latest released specification. It adds explicit major-minor negotiation, functional equivalence across JSON-RPC, gRPC, and HTTP+JSON bindings, task listing and subscription operations, signed and cached Agent Cards, in-task authorization signaling, and documented breaking migrations. Its normative data objects come from the versioned protocol definition rather than the rendered convenience artifact.
reviews.action: Replace the mutable latest link with the versioned 1.0.0 specification. Add binding-equivalence, normative-schema, signed-discovery, authorization-scope, downgrade, and breaking-migration checks while preserving the rule that protocol support is not observed interoperability.
